title: Microbially induced carbonate precipitation (MICP) for soil strengthening: A comprehensive review
abstract: Comprehensive review of MICP for soil strengthening, including ureolysis pathway, cementation mechanisms, spatial uniformity challenges, and environmental considerations of ammonium byproducts.

title: Cementation of sand soil by microbially induced calcite precipitation at various degrees of saturation
abstract: Laboratory study of MICP cementation of sand at various degrees of saturation; improved uniformity of calcite distribution at lower saturation, reducing near-inlet clogging.

title: Experimental Optimization of Microbial-Induced Carbonate Precipitation for Soil Improvement
container: Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering
abstract: Experimental optimization of MICP treatment parameters for sand; reports strength gain and spatial variability of calcium carbonate distribution across the treated zone.

title: Bioprecipitation of calcium carbonate mediated by ureolysis: A review
abstract: Review of ureolysis-mediated carbonate bioprecipitation, covering microbial urease activity, calcite polymorphs, and application in soil improvement.

title: Engineered applications of ureolytic biomineralization: a review
abstract: Review of engineered applications of ureolytic biomineralization including MICP for soil/biocement, with critical discussion of ammonium release.

title: A bio-chemo-hydro-mechanical model for microbially induced calcite precipitation in soils
abstract: Numerical model coupling bio-chemical-hydraulic-mechanical processes for MICP in soils; used to explain heterogeneous calcite distribution.

title: Development of a Reactive Transport Model for Field-Scale Simulation of Microbially Induced Carbonate Precipitation
abstract: Field-scale reactive transport modeling of MICP, examining upscaling from laboratory columns to field geometries and the resulting non-uniform precipitation.

title: Calcium carbonate precipitation catalyzed by soybean urease as an improvement method for fine-grained soil
abstract: EICP approach using soybean urease for fine-grained soil improvement; reports strength and stiffness gains and discusses urease activity.

title: New non-ureolytic heterotrophic microbial induced carbonate precipitation for suppression of sand dune wind erosion
abstract: Non-ureolytic heterotrophic MICP pathway for wind-erosion suppression; avoids ammonium byproducts of ureolysis.

title: Urea Hydrolysis, Conductivity Method for Estimation of Urease Activity
container: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
abstract: Classic conductivity method for estimating urease activity via urea hydrolysis rate; foundational to urease-based MICP/EICP activity measurement.
